summary: Andrew Porter, 25, of Asheville, N.C., and Ian Stasko, 25, of Salt Lake City, Utah, went overdue while elk hunting in the San Juan Wilderness Area west of Trujillo Meadows Reservoir; their car was found at the Rio De Los Pinos Trailhead on Sept 13, 2025 with camping gear and backpacks inside; their bodies were found about two miles from the trailhead on Sept 18 after a massive search; the Conejos County coroner ruled both were killed instantly by a lightning strike to a nearby tree.
location: San Juan Wilderness Area, Rio Grande National Forest, ~2 miles from Rio De Los Pinos Trailhead, west of Trujillo Meadows Reservoir
responding_agency: Conejos County Sheriff's Office; Colorado Search and Rescue (COSAR); New Mexico State Search & Rescue; multi-county/state ground teams; dog teams; drone teams; Flight for Life helicopter; privately owned Black Hawk helicopter
notes: Date approximate: last contact with family Sept 11, 2025; reported overdue Sept 13; bodies found Sept 18; family states the pair were heading back to their car when storms rolled in Sept 12; the coroner said the exact time of death could not be determined.
